text.tspan: Torel Ashgrave, Line-Captain of the Ember Vanguard
Slow. This permanent is a Unit. This Unit's
combat strength is increased by 1 for each
Torel Ashgrave believes uniformity is a weapon

and every identical hull in the Ember Vanguard
